scope: Seed existing upstream source/history only; no new app code or runtime changes. Runtime adapters require separate reviewed bootstrap implementation.
steps: Check target repository absent or empty and private; stop on unexpected content
Create empty private repository only if absent, no README/gitignore initialization
Disable GitHub Actions through repository permissions API and read back enabled=false BEFORE first push
Verify exact source commit/tree/tag via Windows Git read-only UNC; no source Git remote/config/index mutation
Explicit push exact SHA:refs/heads/main to private target; no mirror/all/tags/force or private source refs
Read remote branch SHA and private/Actions status; source tree/licenses/history remain original
Record controls, hashes, command outcomes and NOT_RUN; no app build/start/stop, database access or claim of reproducible runtime
safety: No .env, ignored .codex, customer files or private backups enter source tree at exact upstream commit
No repository made public; no paid feature enabled; actions remain disabled
GitHub rulesets 403 is independent known plan limit, not bypassed
acceptance: Independent plan review PASS before mutations
Private=true and Actions.enabled=false readback before push
Remote main resolves exactly source_commit; original licenses retained at source pin
Source Git status remains clean; no remote/config changes on source
Source baseline sharing is partial ENV-001 progress, not fresh app reproduction or product CI
not_run: Fresh app clone setup, image build, isolated DB prep, application tests/UI and production acceptance
Inherited source Actions review/enablement and targeted product CI
